Risk Management Services

Drop Copy 4.0 Standard Header - CME Globex to Client System - Changed description for:

Tag 49 - Identifies entity sending the message (CME Globex).

Tag 56 - Identifies Drop Copy SenderCompID – seven digit alphanumeric value consisting of:

  • 6-character Drop Copy Target Session ID

  • 1-character Fault Tolerance Indicator = 'N' (no fault tolerance)

For the encapsulated XML message (tag 35-Msg_type=n) message, there will be two tag 56 values.

  1. Tag 56 in the message header identifies Drop Copy SenderCompID.

  2. Tag 56 in the message payload in tag 213-XMLData consists of 2 subcomponents and constants: iLink Source session ID, Firm ID and Fault Tolerance Indicator (FTI). Session ID is the left-most 3 characters. The next 3 characters represent Firm ID. The last character is always the FTI that was sent back on the log-on ack.
    Example: ABC123N
    Session ID: ABC
    Firm ID: 123
    FTI: N (for no fault tolerance)
